user.description:
Remote detected: {remote_id}

Give your remote a name (optional).

error.mqtt_not_configured: MQTT is not configured. Please configure MQTT before adding this integration.
error.no_remote_found: No Haptique RS90 remote found. Make sure it is connected and publishing to MQTT.

dashboard_device.title: Dashboard command buttons
dashboard_device.description: Choose the RS90 device whose buttons you want to pick for the Haptique RS90 dashboard.

dashboard_commands.title: Buttons for {device}
dashboard_commands.description: Which command buttons should the {device} view of the Haptique RS90 dashboard show?

dashboard_pick.title: Buttons for {device}
dashboard_pick.description:
Tick the commands to show as buttons, then **Submit**.

To tick or untick everything at once, pick it in **Shortcut** and **Submit**: the list comes back updated.

wake.title: Wake the RS90 up
wake.description:
Off its dock the RS90 sleeps and stops receiving commands. Home Assistant can wake it up by sending packets to its IP address.

Tip: give the RS90 a fixed IP address (DHCP reservation) in your router.

data.wake_auto: Wake it up automatically before sending a command

data_description.wake_host: Leave empty to disable. Enables the Wake up button of the RS90.
data_description.wake_auto: Macros, apps and device commands then work even while the RS90 sleeps (a few seconds slower).

abort.no_devices: No device received from the RS90 yet. Make sure it is online, then try again.

error.no_commands: Tick at least one command, or choose to hide this device.
